suggested_fix: No fix required. The function computes the range under inode_lock and clamps pg_end to i_size. It rejects compress-released and atomic files, and in-place-update (including pinned) inodes. It waits for writeback before marking pages for GC and limits each pass to one segment. It clears the FI_SKIP_WRITES and FI_OPU_WRITE flags on every exit path. Overflow of range->start + range->len is expected to be checked by the ioctl caller against the maximum file size.
